activity_summary: Oxford by six, twenty miles, and the back no worse. Supper among gowns was nine pence. At the next board a scholar was construing Ovid for a wager, and he was wrong. You did not correct him. You did not repeat his line. You ate.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid, ate, and did not correct the scholar.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Named the twenty miles, and kept him off the other board.

entities.name: nine pence
entities.context: Mentioned in Nine pence, and a wrong wager

facets.activity: Paid nine pence and left the scholar his wager

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I heard him. I am not his tutor.
